components: A known-consistent full snapshot establishes the replay base.
Every later mutation is durably ordered with timestamps or positions.
Recovery chooses a moment immediately before corruption.
Logs apply in order up to, but not beyond, the target.
Consistency checks complete before the restored copy is promoted.
